mapper.select: SELECT idx AS idx_code , code , description FROM CODE WHERE class = 'GENRE' ORDER BY idx

SELECT c.idx AS idx_content , c.title , c.summary , (SELECT cd.description FROM CODE cd WHERE cd.code = c.rating) , (SELECT cd.description FROM CODE cd WHERE cd.code = c.category) , (SELECT cd.description FROM CODE cd WHERE cd.code = c.genre1) , (SELECT cd.description FROM CODE cd WHERE cd.code = c.genre2) , (SELECT cd.description FROM CODE cd WHERE cd.code = c.genre3) , (SELECT cd.description FROM CODE cd WHERE cd.code = c.keyword1) , (SELECT cd.description FROM CODE cd WHERE cd.code = c.keyword2) , (SELECT cd.description FROM CODE cd WHERE cd.code = c.keyword3) , c.director , c.thumbnail , c.thumbnail_filename , c.broadcast_date , c.end_date FROM CONTENT c WHERE c.category = 'MOVIE'
AND ( c.genre1 = #{genre} OR c.genre2 = #{genre} OR c.genre3 = #{genre} )
ORDER BY c.idx DESC
LIMIT ${limit}
